propositions: Automated and manual ticket filers must stamp the detection channel (e.g., canary, CI, review-bot, agent, human-audit, user-report) at creation time via REBAR_DETECTED_BY environment variable or optional --detected-by flag, read at the common create_core seam in composer.py so library, MCP, and CLI callers all capture it.

The detected_by value is normalized by strip() then lowercase; empty or whitespace-only values are treated as unset (field omitted from event); unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum validation, allowing new channels without code changes.

The process_create reducer projects detected_by into compiled_state as an optional present-only field mirroring the source_* blocks; events without detected_by reduce byte-identically to pre-change behavior (additivity proof).
The ticket_state.schema.json schema declares detected_by as an optional string field, and the environment variable is registered in the docs/config registry for drift-gate coverage.
Jira inbound reconciler (apply_inbound_records.py) intentionally bypasses create_core and does not stamp detected_by, correctly leaving Jira-originated tickets unattributed.
